latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of kivicube-web-plugin-ar-xr-builder.

- Provides integration guidance and troubleshooting for building AR/XR experiences with the Kivicube Web Plugin.
- Supports workflows for embedding scenes/collections, custom UIs, camera and photo control, and runtime API usage.
- Includes task maps, best practices, architecture details, and framework integration notes for Vue/React.
- Covers common issues like permissions, CORS, autoplay, and compatibility.
- Matches both English and Chinese AR/XR request patterns.
